name: mnemonic_trace_collapse
label: Echoing Path of Oblivion
godotFeature: Godot Physics engine (CharacterBody3D, RigidBody3D, CollisionShape3D) combined with procedural instancing
poeticVision: The very ground Lyra walks upon remembers her passing, only to immediately forget it with violent collapse. Every stride forward unravels the path behind her into a dangerous void, forcing a desperate, relentless momentum. The player feels their own presence rapidly eroding the world, a direct, physical manifestation of identity loss and the relentless march of forgetting.
usage: Attach this script to a StaticBody3D node that represents a ground tile. This tile must have a MeshInstance3D, a CollisionShape3D, and an Area3D as direct children. The Area3D should also have a CollisionShape3D to define its detection zone. When the player character (a CharacterBody3D named 'Lyra') steps off this tile, a timer starts. Upon timeout, the tile's mesh and collision are disabled, and a pre-configured 'fragment_scene' (a RigidBody3D) is instantiated at the tile's position, given an initial velocity, and then removed after a set duration. The original StaticBody3D tile is then freed.

parameters.name: collapse_delay
parameters.description: Time in seconds before the tile collapses after the player leaves it.

parameters.name: collapse_duration
parameters.description: Time in seconds before the instantiated fragment RigidBody3D is removed from the scene.

parameters.name: fragment_scene
parameters.description: A PackedScene containing a RigidBody3D node (with a MeshInstance3D and CollisionShape3D) that will be instantiated when the tile collapses.

dependencies: StaticBody3D (node this script is attached to)
PackedScene (a .tscn file for the fragment, containing a RigidBody3D with mesh and collision)
verdict: A brilliant mechanic that transforms the abstract terror of forgetting into a tangible, crumbling world underfoot, forcing a desperate dance against oblivion.
impact: The player will experience relentless pressure, a constant visual and physical reminder of Lyra's eroding identity, and a profound sense of urgency. Every step becomes a commitment, every pause a risk, forcing a desperate, forward momentum that perfectly mirrors the narrative's themes of survival against forgetting.
